title: Set up a stage’s alerts
summary: Choose who is alerted and how when an order enters the stage, stays too long or misses its due date.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Lab Stages
steps.details: The stages every lab order goes through, in order.

steps.title: Click the stage’s bell
steps.details: Each stage has its own, on its row.

steps.title: On entering the stage
steps.details: Alerts every time an order reaches this stage. Example: on “Received at clinic”, the doctor, so they book the fitting.

steps.title: Time in stage
steps.details: When the order goes past the stage’s overdue days; once or every X days.

steps.title: Past due date
steps.details: The day after the due date, if the order is still in this stage.

steps.title: Apply
steps.details: Recipients: roles, users, the order’s doctor or its creator. Channels: in-app, email or WhatsApp with a template. Alerts also appear in the Alert Center.
